scope: Physical equipment for lighting and visual show design, from bars and theatres to arenas. Audio/backline is a separate department, not silently included. This is an extensible taxonomy, not a claim to enumerate every product ever manufactured.
method: Practitioner terminology from Blue Room, ControlBooth, r/lightingdesign and r/techtheatre informs navigation. Exact product classification and specifications use manufacturer evidence. Primary category counts each product once; cross-use tags do not manufacture additional coverage.

categories.name: Profile / ellipsoidal (ERS)
categories.definition: Shutter/gobo image-forming theatre profile; fixed or zoom lens.

categories.name: Fresnel wash
categories.definition: Stepped Fresnel optic, soft-edged wash; source technology is a facet.

categories.name: Plano-convex / pebble-convex (PC)
categories.definition: Actual PC optic, not an ERS used as a substitute.

categories.name: PAR and compact wash
categories.definition: Conventional PAR bodies and LED PAR-style washes; lamp type remains a facet.

categories.name: Cyclorama / asymmetric wall wash
categories.definition: Dedicated cyc/floor-wall optics; striplight use tags may overlap.

categories.name: Flood / scoop / area light
categories.definition: Broad area illumination; worklight and house-light application tags are separate.

categories.name: Pinspot / fixed beam / ACL
categories.definition: Fixed narrow-beam function, distinct from audience blinder.

categories.name: Linear batten / striplight
categories.definition: Rigid linear source; independently addressable pixels are a capability.

categories.name: Luminous tube
categories.definition: Visible tubular source; integral or separate controller specified per product.

categories.name: Flexible pixel tape / scenic pixels
categories.definition: Flexible tape or distributed pixel modules; driver is a separate dependency.

categories.name: Practical / decorative / handheld
categories.definition: Visible lamps, bulbs and practical luminaires. Bulb-only records explicitly exclude socket/shade.

categories.name: Dedicated UV / blacklight
categories.definition: Purpose-built UV effect fixture; an RGBWAUV wash is not automatically a dedicated UV fixture.

categories.name: Framing profile
categories.definition: Automated image-forming fixture with framing shutters.

categories.name: Spot / gobo projector
categories.definition: Moving image-forming spotlight without a primary framing-profile designation.

categories.name: Wash
categories.definition: Moving soft coverage, including multi-emitter zoom wash.

categories.name: Beam
categories.definition: Moving narrow-beam aerial effect.

categories.name: Beam / spot / wash hybrid
categories.definition: Manufacturer identifies multi-role hybrid optical system.

categories.name: Moving batten / multi-head bar
categories.definition: Motorized linear fixture or coordinated array, not merely a manually tilted batten.

categories.name: Moving-mirror scanner
categories.definition: Fixed body with motorized mirror; not a moving-head yoke.

categories.name: Manually operated followspot
categories.definition: Operator steers the light; optional DMX intensity does not imply motorized pan/tilt.

categories.name: Strobe
categories.definition: Dedicated flash/strobe system; hybrid blinder capability kept as a use tag.

categories.name: Audience blinder
categories.definition: Audience-facing punch/tungsten-style glow role, distinct from ACL beam arrays.

categories.name: Mirror ball / reflective effect
categories.definition: Passive reflective object; motor and pinspots are separate products.

categories.name: Mirror-ball motor
categories.definition: Dedicated effect rotation motor; not the mirror ball, a chain hoist or an engineered lifting system.

categories.name: Show laser projector
categories.definition: Physical projector only. No exposure model, show output, compliance or operator authorization is supplied.

categories.name: Fog / smoke-look generator
categories.definition: Heated fog-fluid appliance; smoke is a search alias, not proof of combustion.

categories.name: Water-based hazer / fazer
categories.definition: Haze-producing machine with explicitly sourced water-based fluid/process.

categories.name: Oil-based / atomizing hazer
categories.definition: Oil-fluid hazer; record compressor or external gas dependency, do not assume an internal compressor.

categories.name: Low-lying fog
categories.definition: Chilled, ultrasonic or dry-ice systems share the low-fog role; process and consumables are facets.

categories.name: Fog-fluid jet / geyser
categories.definition: Dense fog jet, optionally LED-lit; not a genuine liquid-CO2 jet.

categories.name: Effect fan / airflow appliance
categories.definition: Separate fan for artistic air movement or atmosphere distribution.

research_candidates.note: Official sheet labels fan Ø665 mm, front-view overall width 721 mm, side-view projection 460 mm, and depth 425 mm. The drawing does not make clear whether the 460 mm projection is a pose-dependent yoke dimension or overall height in the intended mounted reference pose; do not map these into a bounding box without clarification.
research_candidates.name: Look-Fan DMX

categories.name: Confetti / streamer launcher
categories.definition: Reusable launcher; disposable cannon and loose consumables are separate inventory.

categories.name: Liquid-CO2 / gas jet
categories.definition: Actual gas-fed effect; cylinder and supply hardware are separate dependencies.

research_candidates.note: Although the manufacturer page lists a 200 x 150 x 130 mm triplet, its matching manual gives 195 x 150 x 130 mm and a conflicting mass; neither clarifies whether the protruding removable output tube is included. The canonical assembled envelope is unresolved.
research_candidates.name: CO2 Jet I

categories.name: Spark-effect appliance
categories.definition: Physical appliance only; do not infer safe operation from the term cold spark.

categories.name: Flame-effect appliance
categories.definition: Physical appliance only; no firing profile, operating settings or safety distances.

categories.name: Water jet / fountain / rain effect
categories.definition: Water-effect hardware and its custom water-management system; not a fogger.

research_candidates.note: Manufacturer lists maximum/variable extents rather than a single fixed pose: total width 370 mm, total height up to 570 mm, total length up to 480 mm, and 275 mm diameter. Do not treat these pose-dependent maximums as a fixed rigid fixture envelope.
research_candidates.name: Fontana Jumping Jet MXP 3000

categories.name: LED display panel
categories.definition: Physical panel module; pixel pitch, processing and rigging compatibility are separate facts.

categories.name: Video projector
categories.definition: Exact body/lens variant; lens throw and network control are metadata.

categories.name: Projection screen / scenic surface
categories.definition: Screen, scrim or mesh; dimensions and material belong to exact/custom variant.

categories.name: Pixel-data controller / tape driver
categories.definition: Protocol conversion and pixel output; a separate power supply may be required. Not automatically power distribution.

categories.name: Followspot tracking / automation control
categories.definition: Control system and sensor hardware; distinct from the fixture being steered.

categories.name: Data cable / connector / termination
categories.definition: Exact cable SKU or parametric cable run; no electrical compatibility inferred from connector shape.

categories.name: Dimmer / switch pack
categories.definition: External power-control appliance; supported load types and regional mains variant must be explicit.

categories.name: Truss / pipe / structural module
categories.definition: Exact series and length; visual geometry does not establish load rating or interoperability.

research_candidates.note: A flexible safety wire has 750 mm length and 3.2 mm cable diameter, but no fixed 3D bounding box in the variable coil/installed pose; retain those source measures without assigning an envelope.
research_candidates.name: KUPO 75 cm Safety Wire (Black)

categories.name: Hoist / winch / motion hardware
categories.definition: Physical model only, not a structural or motion-safety calculation.

categories.name: Custom scenery / set piece
categories.definition: Requires user dimensions or an authored parametric template; there is no universal manufacturer/model.

research_candidates.note: The cited official accessory sheet identifies and illustrates the body-only tube but gives no outer dimensions; do not borrow assembled Source Four dimensions.
research_candidates.name: Source Four 36° EDLT Lens Tube

research_candidates.note: Rosco specifies the 92 mm S-size OD; exact metal thickness for this standard pattern is not published, so no thickness scale claim is made.
research_candidates.name: Rosco 78042 Large Squares

research_candidates.note: Rosco identifies R3008 and standard Cinegel sheet sizes; exact per-variant thickness is not published in the cited product sources and remains unknown.
research_candidates.name: Cinegel R3008 Tough Frost, 20 x 24 in sheet

research_candidates.note: The manual documents aperture range, not the iris assembly’s outer envelope; no fixture dimensions are substituted.
research_candidates.name: Source Four Drop-in Iris

categories.name: Approved effect fluid / consumable
categories.definition: Compatibility must come from manufacturer documentation; a container model is not fluid approval.

categories.name: Gas cylinder / effect supply hardware
categories.definition: Exact supplier and region; physical visualization only.

research_candidates.note: Exact North American 1.5 kg MDG bottle identity is documented, but cylinder dimensions are not published; no standard-cylinder envelope is assumed.
research_candidates.name: MDG CO2 Gas Bottle, 1.5 kg (North American)

planning_objects_not_physical_asset_cate: DMX universes, addresses, modes and signal routes
Cue lists, timelines, timecode and playback effects
Haze density, beams, volumetrics, video content and particle simulations
Zones, sightlines, clearance volumes and operator positions
Approvals, venue restrictions and professional safety review
coverage_rule: A terminal category is represented only by an assigned exact-product record with existing Blender, USDZ and preview files and passing geometry validation. Research-only candidates, component-like geometry embedded in another fixture, simulation effects and generic placeholders do not count. Representative coverage is not exhaustive manufacturer/model coverage.
